claims.claim: TASK-172 changes only ShopeeSourceExtractor internals, focused source/DOM regressions, Product Source Pack/P6.3 docs, and the two canonical roadmaps without modifying schema, resolver, truth, identity, catalog, persistence, retrieval, or browser authority.
Selected-variant observation is derived only inside the positive current-product briefing scope from explicit selected controls; URL/query/model/listing/media heuristics cannot create it.

Variant evidence is all-or-nothing across all deterministically enumerated variation groups: each group has exactly one explicit nonblank selected option and nonblank group label, or zero selected-variant ProductFact values are emitted.

Complete identity-matched selected state appends deterministic ordered ProductFact values with exact key/source_section/provenance contract and embedded exact observed group/option strings, while every pre-existing fact and all media remain unchanged in semantics and order.

Structured identity mismatch, incomplete/ambiguous selected state, and model-like URL query parameters without complete DOM proof all emit zero selected-variant facts without failing an otherwise valid ProductSourcePack extraction.

Compatibility regressions prove unchanged TASK-108 returns EXACT_VARIANT_MATCH for same-listing observations carrying equal complete selected-variant evidence, SAME_PRODUCT_FAMILY for a differing selected option, and SAME_PRODUCT_FAMILY with insufficient variant evidence when selected evidence is absent/incomplete.

One extraction still performs one page/session acquisition, one navigation, and existing bounded media readiness only; no click, second navigation, variant-specific wait/retry, CAPTCHA handling, network/API fallback, or Human selection automation is introduced.

Focused DOM fixtures prove positive-scope selection, deterministic multi-group order, all-or-nothing ambiguity handling, out-of-scope exclusion, and preservation of existing UGC/recommendation/media boundaries fully offline.

Documentation preserves evidence/identity/truth separation, marks TASK-171 P6.3a published, TASK-172 P6.3b current hardening, keeps P6.2 parked/reopenable, and does not claim live exact-variant or live product-truth certification.
Required verification and git diff check pass with zero unresolved items and no changed files outside TASK-172 scope.
